import wbdata
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Define country and indicator
country = ["USA"]
indicator = {"FI.RES.TOTL.CD": "Foreign Reserves"}

# Fetch data from wbdata
df = wbdata.get_dataframe(indicator, country=country)

# Convert index to pandas datetime for proper plotting
df.index = pd.to_datetime(df.index)

# Sort the data by date
df.sort_index(inplace=True)

# Plot the graph
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(df, marker="o", linestyle="-", label="Foreign Reserves")
plt.title("Foreign Reserves (Total Reserves) for USA", fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel("Year", fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel("Foreign Reserves (USD)", fontsize=12)
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import yfinance as yf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Download the data
ticker = "XU100.IS"
start = "2022-01-01"
end = "2024-11-23"
df = yf.download(ticker, start=start, end=end)

df["price"] = df["Adj Close"]

df["Up"] = np.where(df["price"].diff() > 0, df["price"].diff(), 0)
df["Down"] = np.where(df["price"].diff() < 0, -df["price"].diff(), 0)

period = 20
df["MA_Up"] = df["Up"].rolling(window=period).mean()
df["MA_Down"] = df["Down"].rolling(window=period).mean()

df["RSI"] = df["MA_Up"] / (df["MA_Up"] + df["MA_Down"]) * 100

df.dropna(inplace=True)
